resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register pages say 1937; the Oregon Lookouts page documents October 1936 photographs and a crude tower that month, and a December 1936 newsletter item calling the lookout house recently finished. The story reports both years and does not choose one.

notes_for_editor: Build year disputed: 1936 (Oregon Lookouts, from contemporary photographs and a 1936 newsletter item) vs 1937 (both register pages). The story gives both. No source describes the site today, its condition, or public access; access was left out of facts because no source supports a level. The brief's access 'unknown' is unchanged. The 2010 FFLOS registration date from the brief was not visible in fetched text, so no registration event was written. firetower.org shows a 1936 panorama credited to the National Archives Pacific Northwest Region; its licence was not checked, so no photo entry was added. One WebSearch was run; its results were not used as sources.
